public_gates: M808 distinguishes multi-axis replay coverage from source-diverse primary-window pass
M808 decides whether another retargeting milestone is justified or branch synthesis is required
M808 blocks residual calibration, PPO, and promotion unless the audit explicitly admits a safe diagnostic-only continuation
forbidden_shortcuts: do not treat one-axis accepted rows as source-diverse pass
do not weaken the primary 0.00005 margin threshold
do not weaken seed source fault or axis dominance thresholds
do not tune from private holdout failures

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits whether M807's multi-axis replay result should end this retargeting sub-branch or admit a new diagnostic route
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: audit decision only; no residual calibration PPO or driver promotion
stop_condition: stop if the only next step is accepting half-width rows as source-diverse
stop if another narrow retargeting milestone would exceed the synthesis trigger
fallback_plan: if M807 is clean geometry-only, write branch synthesis or pivot to a new data-generation route
if M807 has tooling artifacts, repair the retarget tool first
if M807 unexpectedly passes, route to active-steer calibration design only after audit
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M807 expands retarget axes but accepted rows remain geometry-only

hypothesis: M807 is a clean geometry-only diagnostic and the current retargeting branch needs an audit before more corpus mining.
success_criteria: M808 documents supported and falsified claims from M807
M808 classifies whether the branch should continue pivot or synthesize
M808 keeps residual calibration, PPO, and promotion blocked unless a safe diagnostic-only continuation is justified
failure_criteria: audit treats one-axis accepted rows as source-diverse pass
audit ignores the synthesis trigger after repeated low-margin retargeting misses

commands.name: audit
commands.command: write docs/m808-v4-low-margin-boundary-axis-expansion-audit.md from M807 artifacts; no training command

decision_rule: M808 may only audit M807 and choose the next blocker. It must not train, run PPO, mutate actor or residual parameters, or promote a checkpoint.
